summary: Executed eight exposed synthetic candidate cases from a protocol frozen before execution. Existing path descriptor, Dev72 sensor and exact hallway profile/edge_pair source compose usefully as separate evidence. At a crossing, designated one-turn and competing straight candidates have identical 240px length, support36/41, pairs38/41 and zero observed midpoint offset: fewer-bend preference picks the other construction endpoint. An unsupported shortcut is shorter and has fewer turns with zero conditional midpoint offset, yet substantially lower support/pair coverage. Same-length zero-turn routes differ by8px midpoint offset. Wrong expected width changes normalized length and sensor score on the same centerline, with all failed pairs retained UNKNOWN. This is new composition evidence rather than another old straight/six-bend score tie. No score, accepted weight, routing change, physical course accuracy or human acceptance is claimed.
